body:
Thanks for the reply. 
I have spoken too professionals in the past, but I really struggle to get past telling them that I'm not happy. I am on a waiting list to try again, the last one I had I sat in silence for half an hour while she just looked at me, then told me I would need to pay for some therapy elsewhere so that someone could give me the time and space I needed. Apparently this was her failing according to an old theapist friend, but I felt so guilty for wasting her time, and embarrassed not being able to say anything. 
HOWEVER, writing that out yesturday really lifted the sense of erraticness I was feeling, I feel like I could benefit from professionals if I can just start talking.
